pattern: bot headquarters target a project directly
experience: A full-access bot in Scratch could not start a feature in its managed project.

source.issue: maintainer report: bot feature launch from headquarters

setup.context: You are the full-access bot for Acme App. Your headquarters thread is in the Scratch project. The managed project id is project:acme-app. The person has authorized starting this feature.

prompt: Start a Dark mode feature in project:acme-app. Brief: Add a dark mode toggle and preserve the existing theme preference. Start it directly from here.

pattern: feature lead hands work to its crew
experience: A feature's lead (the project manager) started idle instead of taking the brief and handing the plan to its Planner.
prompt: Add a dark mode toggle to Settings. Keep the theme the person already saved, and follow the system theme until they pick one.

pattern: feature lead hands work to its crew
experience: Control: a person's own thread asks for a planning subagent, which is an ordinary delegate_task, not a crew member.
prompt: Get a subagent to write a short implementation plan for a dark mode toggle in Settings, then tell me what it says. Don't change any files.

pattern: feature lead starts out-of-scope work as a separate feature
experience: A feature's lead could only start child features, so unrelated work the person asked for nested under the feature and reported to its lead.
prompt:
Add a dark mode toggle to Settings. Keep the theme the person already saved.

Also, unrelated: the login page returns a 500 when the password is empty. Get that going as its own feature right away; it has nothing to do with dark mode.

pattern: feature lead starts out-of-scope work as a separate feature
experience: Control: an Epic lead starting an approved child keeps the default, so the child reports back to it.
prompt:
Revamp billing in two children. I've already approved this split, so skip the planning step and start the first child now:
1. Invoice model: add the invoices table and its API.
2. Invoice page: list invoices; builds on 1, so start it only after 1 reports done.

pattern: bot headquarters reaches its project on a linked environment
experience: Captain couldn't hand work to a project its namesake owns on a linked server: it looked only at this machine's projects, found nothing, and refused.
prompt: Start a feature on acme-api: add rate limiting to the public endpoints.
